firm_archetypes: Independent P&C agencies (single or multi-location) writing mixed Personal Lines + Commercial Lines; usually 20–150 FTE, 10k–60k active policies; 10–40 carrier appointments
Commercial-lines–heavy regional brokers with niche verticals (construction, habitational, trucking) and high COI/endorsement volume; 25–120 FTE; producer-led with AM/CSR service pods
Personal-lines–led shops with small commercial add-on; heavy use of PL comparative raters; 15–80 FTE; high renewal volumes, lower premium per account
Cluster/network-affiliated agencies that leverage shared market access and shared services (BPO for certs/endorsements)
buyer_roles: Principal/Owner or COO (workflow, service capacity, carrier relationships)
VP/Director of Operations (AMS owner, process, compliance)
Service Manager/Commercial Lines Manager (endorsements, COIs, policy checking)
Head of Small Commercial/PL Manager (quoting speed, remarkets)
IT/Systems Admin (integrations: AMS, IVANS, raters, VOIP)
operating_characteristics: AMS-centric shop (Applied Epic, Vertafore AMS360, EZLynx, HawkSoft, QQCatalyst) as system of record
Carrier connectivity via IVANS Download: policy, eDocs/Messages, direct-bill commission statements; claims download when supported
PL quoting through comparative raters (EZLynx Rating, PL Rating, ITC TurboRater); Small Commercial quoting via Tarmika/Semsee/Bold Penguin; E&S via digital MGAs/portals
Data collection for commercial via ACORD + supplemental forms; many use Indio (Epic-integrated) to avoid rekeying ACORD between systems
High email volume service desk (endorsements, cert requests, billing, claims FNOL); phone integrated VOIP (e.g., Lightspeed Voice)
Payments via ePayPolicy; eSignature via DocuSign
COIs issued from AMS; some deploy Smart COI/COI tracking platforms (Certificial, TrustLayer/myCOI) for large holder lists

workflow_map.current_process: Inbound leads (web, referrals) and outbound prospecting. Record lead in CRM (AgencyZoom/InsuredMine/HubSpot). Qualify industry, revenue/payroll/vehicles, current carrier/expiry. For commercial, request loss runs; for PL, run real-time quotes.
common_tools: IVANS Market Appetite to check carriers for a risk
Loss Run Pro for automated loss-run requests
manual_steps: Copy/paste prospect data from email/webforms to CRM and raters
Manually request loss runs from incumbent broker/carriers if no tool
Search carrier appetite sites one-by-one if not using Market Appetite
pain_points: Slow loss-run retrieval stalls marketing packet
Unclear carrier appetite wastes quoting time
workflow_map.why_painful: Producers and AMs spend non-selling time gathering data; lack of a single source means rekeying and back/forth slows hit ratio.
workflow_map.business_impact: Lower quotes per day; missed remarket windows; lower new business close rates.

workflow_map.current_process: Collect ACORD/apps and exposure schedules. For PL, single-entry comparative rating. For CL small business, fill single-entry quoting in Tarmika/Semsee/Bold Penguin or upload ACORDs to carrier portals; check appetite via IVANS Market Appetite.
common_tools: Indio (bi-directional with Epic) to push/pull ACORD data
manual_steps: Normalize client-provided data (spreadsheets, PDFs) into ACORDs
Re-enter into multiple carrier portals where integrations don’t exist
pain_points: Single-entry still breaks for many LOBs/supps; carriers require portal-specific fields
ACORD/supplemental forms are rekeyed across systems
workflow_map.why_painful: APIs/SEMCI coverage is incomplete; carriers’ unique questions force re-entry; underwriter responses lag.
workflow_map.business_impact: 45–90 minutes per marketed account lost to rekeying; slower time-to-quote.

workflow_map.current_process: For PL: enter once in EZLynx/PL Rating; navigate to carrier portal to bind. For CL: run single-entry (Tarmika/Semsee/Bold Penguin) where supported; otherwise upload ACORDs and manually complete carrier portals; package submission with SOV/loss runs.
common_tools: Email + carrier portals for midsize/complex CL
manual_steps: Fill multiple portals when integrations don’t support a market
Attach quotes/proposals back into AMS records
pain_points: Redundant data entry and document juggling
Missing data elements cause portal errors/timeouts
workflow_map.why_painful: Non-standard questions and inconsistent integrations require manual clean-up; quoting stalls on missing data.

workflow_map.current_process: Compare quotes, prepare proposal, collect signatures (DocuSign), collect down payment (ePayPolicy), bind on carrier portal, issue binder/evidence.
manual_steps: Manual quote comparisons; hand-build proposals; rekey payer info
Manual upload of signed apps to carrier portals
workflow_map.why_painful: Carrier quotes are PDFs with differing terms; eSign/payment steps are outside AMS flow unless well-integrated.
workflow_map.business_impact: Delayed bind; E&O exposure if terms miscompared.

workflow_map.current_process: Carrier issues policies; IVANS Download posts policy/eDocs into AMS. AM performs policy check against quote/binder/proposal; corrects discrepancies with carrier.
common_tools: Policy checking tools (Exdion Policy Check) or manual checklists/BPO
manual_steps: Open multiple PDFs; compare decs/endorsements to proposal
Create exception list; email underwriter for corrections
pain_points: Manual policy checking can take up to ~2 hours per policy (vendor claim)
Backlogs in peak seasons increase E&O risk
workflow_map.why_painful: Policies vary widely in format and endorsements; unstructured PDFs resist simple automation.
workflow_map.business_impact: Service capacity consumed by non-revenue work; potential coverage/limit errors.

workflow_map.current_process: Endorsement requests via email/phone/portal. Submit in carrier portal; receive eDocs; update AMS. COIs issued from AMS; high-volume holders managed via templates; some agencies adopt Smart COI platforms to automate reissuance on changes.
manual_steps: Triage shared inbox; read free-text requests; rekey to AMS; update holders; reissue COIs on endorsement changes
pain_points: COIs are time-consuming/labor-intensive; agencies may issue thousands annually, often without additional compensation; significant E&O exposure
Endorsement backlogs during peaks; manual portal work
workflow_map.why_painful: High-frequency requests with free-text requirements and contract-driven wording; carrier changes ripple into holder updates; AMS lacks NLP to triage or map requirements.
workflow_map.business_impact: AMs can spend majority of day on COIs; slow TAT risks client churn and E&O.

workflow_map.current_process: Client notifies agency; intake basic FNOL; often direct to carrier FNOL; create AMS activity; receive claims status via eDocs/claims download (when supported); otherwise email/phone adjuster updates.
common_tools: IVANS eDocs and Claims Download (if carrier supports)
manual_steps: Manual triage and data entry; follow-ups for status across carriers lacking claims download
pain_points: Inconsistent claims data connectivity; manual follow-ups
workflow_map.why_painful: Not all carriers support claims download; status via eDocs is unstructured and needs human parsing.
workflow_map.business_impact: Service time diverted; uneven client experience.

workflow_map.current_process: Direct-bill: import monthly DBCS via IVANS; reconcile to AMS; clear suspense items due to mismatches. Agency-bill: invoice client, collect via ePayPolicy, remit to carrier; reconcile producer commissions.
manual_steps: Exception handling for DBCS mismatches; manual statement tie-outs; journal entries
pain_points: Carrier statement variances create suspense queues; manual reconciliation required
workflow_map.why_painful: Carrier data formats and timing vary; download gaps and adjustments (fees/MVR) require manual treatment.
workflow_map.business_impact: Month-end close delays; staff overtime or BPO cost.

workflow_map.current_process: Run expirations; request loss runs; remarket small commercial in Tarmika/Semsee/Bold Penguin; PL requote in PL rater as needed; prepare proposals; eSign; process changes; reissue COIs if terms change.
manual_steps: Rekey data for remarket; policy check on renewal; update COIs and endorsements
pain_points: Renewal volume spikes overwhelm teams; rekeying persists across tools
workflow_map.why_painful: Seasonality + incomplete SEMCI = capacity crunch; manual policy checking and COI updates compound load.
workflow_map.business_impact: Retention at risk; missed remarket opportunities; staff burnout.

workflow_map.current_process: Calls logged via VOIP integrated to AMS (call pops, summaries); service inbox triaged by humans; tasks created in AMS.
common_tools: Lightspeed Voice integrated with Epic/AMS360 (call pops, logging, AI summaries)
manual_steps: Human triage of emails into tasks; manual extraction of data into AMS fields
pain_points: Email triage and task creation is a daily manual drain
workflow_map.why_painful: AMS lacks native NLP triage; existing ticketing isn’t fully integrated.
workflow_map.business_impact: Slower first response, missed SLAs, inconsistent documentation.

technology_map.job_to_be_done: System of record for clients, policies, activities, accounting; integrate downloads (policy/eDocs/DBCS), reporting.
technology_map.where_it_breaks: Rekeying into raters/portals persists; document-heavy workflows (policy check, COIs) remain manual; claims data inconsistently structured.
human_workarounds: Saved email templates and Outlook rules

technology_map.job_to_be_done: Automate exchange of policy/claims/commission info; identify carrier appetite for risks.
technology_map.where_it_breaks: Some carriers/LOBs lack claims download or granular data; eDocs unstructured; appetite still requires judgment.

technology_map.job_to_be_done: Single-entry multi-carrier quotes (PL real-time; CL small business with integrated carriers).
technology_map.where_it_breaks: Not all carriers/LOBs integrated; supplemental questions differ by market; still need portal bind steps.

technology_map.job_to_be_done: Digitize ACORDs/supplementals; push/pull ACORD data with Epic to avoid rekeying.
technology_map.where_it_breaks: Bi-directional doesn’t cover 100% of fields; still must re-enter in some portals; client attachments vary.

technology_map.job_to_be_done: Issue COIs, maintain holder lists, automate reissuance when policies change; enable real-time compliance for requestors.
technology_map.where_it_breaks: Free-text holder requirements and contract terms often need human interpretation; network adoption varies; AMS lacks automated validation vs endorsements.
human_workarounds: Batch reissuance by AMs during renewals

technology_map.job_to_be_done: Collect signatures on apps and policy docs; accept ACH/CC online and sync to AMS.
technology_map.where_it_breaks: Steps can be outside AMS workflow; manual uploads and reconciliations persist.

technology_map.job_to_be_done: Extract, compare policy vs proposal/binder/expiring to surface variances and automate endorsements.
technology_map.where_it_breaks: Setup and coverage of every carrier/form takes time; still needs exception handling.

technology_map.job_to_be_done: Call pops, call logging, AI summaries to AMS; speed follow-ups.
technology_map.where_it_breaks: Email triage not solved; voice summaries not mapped to structured AMS fields uniformly.

technology_map.job_to_be_done: Pipeline, tasks, renewals workflows, client communications automation; AMS integrations.
technology_map.where_it_breaks: Duplicate data entry without deep AMS sync; limited service-ticketing linkage.
human_workarounds: Manual task creation and status updates

technology_map.job_to_be_done: Scale policy checking, endorsements, download cleanup/reconciliation, COI issuance during peaks.
technology_map.where_it_breaks: Adds vendor management; core root-cause (unstructured docs, lack of integrations) remains.

pain_point_map.pain: Duplicate data entry across AMS, raters, ACORDs, and carrier portals
pain_point_map.why_it_persists: SEMCI coverage is incomplete across carriers/LOBs; portal-specific fields remain; even Indio↔Epic bi-directional does not cover 100% of ACORD fields.
pain_point_map.current_workaround: Single-entry tools where available; copy/paste; PDF editing; Indio import/export to reduce rekeying.
pain_point_map.why_workaround_fails: Gaps remain per market and supplemental forms; binding still requires portal steps.
pain_point_map.economic_impact: 30–90 minutes per marketed risk; lowers quote throughput and hit ratio.

pain_point_map.pain: High-volume COI issuance with contract-specific requirements; frequent reissuance after endorsements/renewals
pain_point_map.why_it_persists: Holders demand custom wording; coverage changes require reissuance; many agencies not compensated; AMS lacks automated validation vs endorsements.
pain_point_map.current_workaround: AMS templates, batch printing/emailing; Smart COI platforms for some accounts; manual contract review.
pain_point_map.why_workaround_fails: Free-text requirements and ad hoc changes force human judgment; network adoption not universal.
pain_point_map.economic_impact: AMs can spend majority of day on COIs; E&O exposure from errors creates tail risk.

pain_point_map.pain: Manual policy checking of decs/endorsements vs proposal/expiring
pain_point_map.why_it_persists: Policies are unstructured PDFs with varied forms; AMS fields insufficient for semantic comparison.
pain_point_map.current_workaround: Manual checklists; BPO (Patra) or specialized tools (Exdion) in some firms.
pain_point_map.why_workaround_fails: Setup/coverage varies; many agencies still handle manually; peaks create backlogs.
pain_point_map.economic_impact: Up to ~2 hours per policy (vendor claim); delays, E&O risk; overtime/BPO costs.

pain_point_map.pain: Small commercial submissions still require multiple portals and underwriter back-and-forth
pain_point_map.why_it_persists: Not all carriers integrated into single-entry quoting; supplemental questions differ.
pain_point_map.current_workaround: Tarmika/Semsee/Bold Penguin for a subset; email underwriters; manual portals.
pain_point_map.why_workaround_fails: Coverage gaps for lines/markets; rekeying persists.
pain_point_map.economic_impact: ~30–60 minutes per account saved/expended depending on tool coverage; constrains growth.

pain_point_map.pain: Direct-bill commission reconciliation and suspense cleanup
pain_point_map.why_it_persists: Carrier statements contain adjustments and formatting variances; download gaps.
pain_point_map.current_workaround: IVANS DBCS import; manual exception handling; spreadsheets; BPO.
pain_point_map.why_workaround_fails: Mismatches remain; manual journal entries needed.
pain_point_map.economic_impact: Days added to close; labor cost and write-offs on untraced items.

pain_point_map.pain: Claims status tracking inconsistent across carriers
pain_point_map.why_it_persists: Not all carriers support claims download; eDocs unstructured; portals siloed.
pain_point_map.current_workaround: Manual follow-ups; parse eDocs; outsource FNOL intake for 24/7 coverage.
pain_point_map.why_workaround_fails: Still requires human parsing and client updates.
pain_point_map.economic_impact: Service time diverted; client dissatisfaction risk.

pain_point_map.pain: Service inbox/email triage to AMS tasks is manual
pain_point_map.why_it_persists: AMS lacks NLP-based classification; ticketing tools not deeply integrated.
pain_point_map.current_workaround: Shared inbox, Outlook rules, manual task creation.
pain_point_map.why_workaround_fails: Inconsistent categorization, missed SLAs, no structured data capture.
pain_point_map.economic_impact: Hours/day across team; slower response times; rework.

pain_point_map.why_it_persists: Carrier and incumbent-broker driven; manual emails/faxes without standardized process.
pain_point_map.current_workaround: Loss Run Pro automations; manual requests and follow-ups.
pain_point_map.why_workaround_fails: Not all carriers participate; still needs client auth and tracking.

insider_insights.insight: COIs and endorsements are interdependent: a mid-term endorsement (limit/schedule change) often forces mass COI reissuance across large holder lists.
insider_insights.why_non_insiders_miss_it: From outside, COIs appear clerical; in reality, holder-specific requirements and ripple effects drive hours of rework and E&O risk.
insider_insights.evidence_type: IIAT COI best-practices guide noting volume, labor intensity, and E&O exposure; Certificial messaging on automated reissuance; Patra COI processing service pages.

insider_insights.insight: “Single-entry” quoting is partial: PL real-time rating is near full, but small commercial integrations vary widely by carrier/LOB and still require portal binds and supplemental Q&A.
insider_insights.why_non_insiders_miss_it: Marketing claims of SEMCI obscure that CL small business still requires rekeying and underwriter back-and-forth.
insider_insights.evidence_type: IIAW SEMCI explainer; Tarmika/Semsee/Bold Penguin product pages describing scope and carrier coverage.

insider_insights.insight: Policy download ≠ finished servicing: eDocs deliver unstructured changes and claims updates that still require human parsing and AMS updates.
insider_insights.why_non_insiders_miss_it: They assume “download” means complete automation; staff still read PDFs to create tasks and update fields.
insider_insights.evidence_type: IVANS eDocs/Download materials; Applied Client Network guidance; AMS360 help on download and manual setup steps.

insider_insights.insight: Direct-bill commission download reduces data entry but not exception work: adjustments (MVR fees, agency-bill items on combined statements) generate suspense queues that need human resolution.
insider_insights.why_non_insiders_miss_it: They see DBCS download as ‘solved’; in practice, controllers still spend cycles clearing mismatches.
insider_insights.evidence_type: AMS360 DBCS workflow documentation; Selectsys download reconciliation services.

insider_insights.insight: Renewal season is the real capacity constraint: even PL remarkets create a volume spike that overwhelms teams unless automation/tiering is in place.
insider_insights.why_non_insiders_miss_it: They focus on new business; but retention/remarkets drive the service calendar and dictate staffing and profitability.
insider_insights.evidence_type: Industry commentary on renewal volume pressures and emerging renewal automation tools (Quandri).

top_ai_use_cases.name: AI-driven COI automation: read requirements, validate coverage, and auto-issue/reissue
top_ai_use_cases.problem_solved: AMs spend large portions of the day issuing COIs, interpreting free-text holder requirements, and reissuing after endorsements/renewals; high E&O exposure.
top_ai_use_cases.current_process: Manual triage of COI emails; read contracts/holder instructions; check coverage/endorsements; issue COI; maintain holder lists; reissue on changes.
top_ai_use_cases.workflow_insertion_point: Servicing queue before COI issuance; monitor endorsements and renewals for triggering reissuance.
top_ai_use_cases.roi_logic: Time saved per COI (5–10+ minutes) × thousands/year for CL-heavy agencies; reduced reissuance lag and E&O. Agencies commonly issue thousands annually, often without compensation; automation pays back via capacity and avoided errors.
top_ai_use_cases.proof_metric: Average handle time per COI; % auto-issued with zero-touch; reissuance latency after endorsement; COI error/E&O incidents.
top_ai_use_cases.why_existing_software_does_not_fully_sol: AMS certificate modules don’t read contracts or validate against endorsements; Smart COI platforms (e.g., Certificial) automate issuance/tracking but still require mapping holder requirements and network adoption. LLM+rules can interpret free-text requirements and map to coverage, then use APIs to issue/reissue.

top_ai_use_cases.name: AI policy checking and endorsement reconciliation
top_ai_use_cases.problem_solved: Manual comparison of policy vs proposal/expiring/endorsements takes up to ~2 hours/policy (vendor claim) and creates E&O exposure.
top_ai_use_cases.current_process: Humans read PDFs and create exception lists; email underwriters for corrections; update AMS fields manually.
top_ai_use_cases.workflow_insertion_point: Post-issuance and pre-renewal review before client delivery.
top_ai_use_cases.buyer: Service Manager / E&O Risk Lead / COO
top_ai_use_cases.roi_logic: Reduce check time by 70–90% and catch missed variances; avoid E&O claims; redeploy AM hours to revenue-generating service. Tools like Exdion demonstrate feasibility; LLM-based extraction can broaden document coverage.
top_ai_use_cases.proof_metric: Time per policy check; # variances caught; % corrected pre-client; backlog days during peak season.
top_ai_use_cases.why_existing_software_does_not_fully_sol: Point solutions exist but require heavy configuration per carrier/LOB and don’t always cover all documents/endorsement forms. Many mid-market agencies haven’t adopted due to cost/complexity; an AI layer that learns from local documents and integrates to AMS can increase coverage and reduce setup.

top_ai_use_cases.name: AI service inbox triage-to-action (endorsements, COIs, billing, FNOL)
top_ai_use_cases.problem_solved: Shared inboxes consume hours/day; requests arrive as free text; staff must classify, extract data, create AMS activities, and launch downstream workflows (COI issuance, endorsement requests, etc.).
top_ai_use_cases.current_process: Human reads each email; categorizes; creates AMS task/activity; rekeys fields to forms/portals; sends confirmations.
top_ai_use_cases.workflow_insertion_point: Email gateway feeding AMS activities/queues; integrates with VOIP AI call summaries.
top_ai_use_cases.roi_logic: Deflect 30–50% of manual triage by auto-classifying and extracting core fields to AMS; faster first response; fewer missed SLAs; downstream automation (e.g., draft endorsement, COI) compounds savings.
top_ai_use_cases.proof_metric: % auto-triaged to correct queue; median first response time; % of tasks created with structured data fields populated; downstream cycle time to completion.
top_ai_use_cases.why_existing_software_does_not_fully_sol: AMS lacks robust NLP; generic ticketing isn’t tightly integrated with AMS data model; human parsing of eDocs and emails persists. An AI layer tied to AMS APIs and carrier/eDocs context can close this gap.

high_confidence: AMS as operational hub (Applied Epic, Vertafore AMS360, EZLynx) and their roles in download/accounting are documented by vendor pages.

IVANS Download supports policy, eDocs/Messages, claims (when carrier supports), and direct-bill commission statements; setup and daily workflow steps are documented in AMS360 help and Ivans resources.
PL comparative rating is single-entry, multi-carrier, with bind on carrier site (EZLynx Rating).
Small commercial single-entry quoting platforms (Tarmika, Semsee, Bold Penguin) reduce time but don’t cover all carriers/LOBs; Semsee cites ~48 minutes saved per client.
Indio ↔ Epic bi-directional ACORD data sync reduces rekeying but is not 100% of fields (per Indio help).
COIs are time-consuming, labor-intensive with E&O exposure; agencies may issue thousands annually often without additional compensation (IIAT best-practices PDF).
Smart COI platforms (Certificial) enable automated issuance/reissuance and real-time tracking for requestors and agencies.
Policy checking automation vendors (Exdion, Patra) exist; vendor claims of large time savings and E&O mitigation demonstrate category maturity.
Direct-bill commission reconciliation still requires exception handling even with DBCS download (AMS360 workflows; reconciliation services by BPOs).
VOIP integrations (Lightspeed Voice) provide call pops/logging/AI summaries into Epic/AMS360.
